title: Tom and the Comic Strip
text:
Tom likes comic strips. Every morning he reads a funny comic strip in the newspaper. The comic strip has a dog named Max. Max always wants food.

Today Tom draws his own comic strip. He draws a cat and a dog. The cat is very funny. His friends laugh when they see it.

questions.text: What does Tom read every morning?
options: a comic strip in the newspaper
The cat is very funny in Tom's comic strip.

questions.text: What can we infer about Tom?

vocabulary.definition: printed paper with news and articles, published every day or week
causing people to laugh or smile
makes a picture with a pencil or pen
to make sounds showing that something is funny

paragraph_translations: A Tom le gustan las tiras cómicas. Cada mañana lee una tira cómica graciosa en el periódico. La tira cómica tiene un perro llamado Max. Max siempre quiere comida.
Hoy Tom dibuja su propia tira cómica. Dibuja un gato y un perro. El gato es muy gracioso. Sus amigos se ríen cuando lo ven.
